stories.title: Parents’ lawyers give Flintshire Council 24 hours to reveal true cost of £55m Catholic super-school plan
stories.summary: An eight-page legal letter by parents is demanding Flintshire Council answers key questions and provides a full updated cost for its Catholic super-school plan by tomorrow. stories.title: Dog exercise paddock owner to appeal after Flintshire planning committee refuses Penymynydd scheme
stories.summary: The owner of a proposed dog exercise facility which has failed to secure planning permission says he will appeal as he cannot understand why his plans have been refused. stories.title: Airbus launches three-year flight test campaign for Wing of Tomorrow programme
stories.summary: Airbus is to flight test longer wings for its next generation of single-aisle aircraft in a new three-year campaign under its Wing of Tomorrow research programme. stories.title: Electricity bill tax cut expected to take around £45 a year off household bills
stories.summary: VAT on household electricity bills will be scrapped from 1 October, a change the UK government estimates will take around £45 a year off a typical bill for homes across Flintshire. stories.title: Meningitis B vaccine rollout begins for young people in Wales
stories.summary: Young people in Wales are being offered the meningitis B vaccine from today as part of a nationwide rollout ahead of the new academic year.
